rules.stop: One record per eligible Stop; skipped/no-key/cap/circuit records make no outgoing call.
rules.tool: Only facts.kind=jev may carry a call. Floor records and cached target hits make no Jev call.
rules.fold: One batch per session and timestamp; at most 24 rows. Usage is on the first row only; at most 48 sampled results per compaction.
rules.instructions: One batch per session, prompt joinKey and timestamp. Its usage is copied onto every fragment decision, including keyword decisions alongside a Jev call; count that usage once.
rules.instr-filter: Only decision=sent is a call record, one per scope-1 or cover-1 request. Per-chunk readings carry no additional usage.
rules.instr-defer: One batch per session, request joinKey and timestamp. Usage appears on the first deferred chunk only.
rules.instr-tool: A deterministic observed tool-use signature, never a Jev call.

limits: Per-device live acceptance belongs to phase 1, not this accounting fixture.
Missing usage is unknown, not zero. Expected call count must come from the independent study ledger.
Expected record multiplicities and missing individual batch members are checked by the device-case manifest.
